items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Paul Webster in the context of places where musicians met, but the interviewee does not explicitly confirm a personal relationship or interaction with him.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, he'll feel better. There's no doubt. If you can get the meal down, you know. But it seems like most of the older generation, they drank whiskey, you know. Like we were talking about the places in New York, yesterday,

when we were coming from a blues memorial service yesterday, about the New York places you used to meet all the musicians, Jim & Andy's , the Turf, the Copper: /, the other one that you were mentioning where Paul Webster and Hilton --
